dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Visible as high-contrast, thick white horizontal bands across the greater and median coverts.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Sharp, prominent white boundaries are visible along the edges of the folded primary and secondary feathers against the dark feather bodies.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white terminal band and lateral edging on the tail rectrices.
